import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements by Species', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Define color palette
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# Plot 1: Pairplot-style scatter - Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(data['sepal_length'], data['sepal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Pairplot-style scatter - Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(data['petal_length'], data['petal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 3: Box plot for all measurements
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
measurement_data = []
labels = []
species_list = []
for col in ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']:
    for species in df['species'].unique():
        measurement_data.append(df[df['species'] == species][col].values)
        labels.append(col.replace('_', ' ').title().replace('Sepal', 'Sep').replace('Petal', 'Pet'))
        species_list.append(species)

positions = []
tick_positions = []
tick_labels = []
current_pos = 0
for i, col in enumerate(['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']):
    col_positions = []
    for j, species in enumerate(df['species'].unique()):
        idx = i * 3 + j
        positions.append(current_pos)
        col_positions.append(current_pos)
        current_pos += 1
    tick_positions.append(sum(col_positions) / len(col_positions))
    tick_labels.append(col.replace('_', '\n').title())
    current_pos += 0.5

bp = ax3.boxplot(measurement_data, positions=positions, widths=0.6, patch_artist=True,
                 showfliers=False, medianprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=2))

for patch, species in zip(bp['boxes'], species_list):
    patch.set_facecolor(colors[species])
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax3.set_xticks(tick_positions)
ax3.set_xticklabels(tick_labels, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of All Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Create custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=colors[s], label=s.capitalize(), alpha=0.7) 
                  for s in df['species'].unique()]
ax3.legend(handles=legend_elements, title='Species', loc='upper left', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)

# Plot 4: Violin plot for petal length (most discriminative feature)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values 
                        for species in df['species'].unique()],
                       positions=[0, 1, 2], widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)

for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(list(colors.values())[i])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')

ax4.set_xticks([0, 1, 2])
ax4.set_xticklabels([s.capitalize() for s in df['species'].unique()], fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
